measures.title: County Chair Appointed by Elected County Council Members and More Restrictive County Council Term Limits
measures.summary: Has the County Council appoint one of its own members as county chair each year, for no more than two consecutive one-year terms as chair. Returns the County Council to a seven-member body of five district members and two at-large members. No Council member could appear on the ballot if they would have served eight consecutive years by the end of their current term.
measures.yesMeans: The Council picks its own chair each year, the Council has five district and two at-large members, and the stricter term limit applies.
measures.noMeans: The Charter's current provisions for the county chair, Council membership and term limits stay in place.

measures.title: Removal of Charter Limitations Regarding Reimbursement of Work-Related Expenses Incurred by County Council Members
measures.summary: Removes the limits the County Charter now places on reimbursing County Council members for work-related expenses.
measures.yesMeans: The Charter's limits on reimbursing Council members' work-related expenses are removed.
measures.noMeans: The Charter's current limits on reimbursing Council members' work-related expenses stay in place.

measures.title: Amend Charter to Reflect Changes Made to Florida Constitution as to County Constitutional Officers
measures.summary: Repeals Charter provisions about county constitutional officers that were superseded in 2018 when voters amended Article VIII, Section 1 of the Florida Constitution. It replaces superseded or obsolete provisions so the Charter matches the state constitution.
measures.yesMeans: The superseded provisions about county constitutional officers are removed from the Charter and replaced.
measures.noMeans: The superseded provisions remain in the Charter text.

measures.title: Remove Personnel Administration Provisions from Charter and Require Such be Established by Ordinance
measures.summary: Removes the personnel administration provisions from the County Charter. The County Council would instead have to set personnel administration rules by ordinance.
measures.yesMeans: Personnel administration rules move out of the Charter and must be adopted by County Council ordinance.
measures.noMeans: Personnel administration provisions stay in the Charter.

measures.title: Establish Registry Increasing County Council Voting Requirement for Transfer of Conservation Land
measures.summary: Creates a conservation land registry. Land could be added to or removed from it only by a majority-plus-one vote of the entire County Council, with added notice requirements for removal. Registered land could not be conveyed unless the Council finds it is no longer needed for conservation, with exceptions for public purposes and eminent domain takings.
measures.yesMeans: A conservation land registry is created and registered land gets added protection against being sold or transferred.
measures.noMeans: No conservation land registry is created in the Charter.
